title: Closures Contract
description: Standard schema for active barriers, elevator outages, and path construction across UMass Amherst. Adhered to by Role 1 (Routing), Role 2 (Frontend), Role 3 (Scraper), and Role 4 (Backend).

id.description: Unique identifier for this outage or barrier

radius.description: Affected barrier radius in meters (snapped to nearest graph edge)

source.description: Source of data: official UMass facilities notice, community report, or field-verified

title.description: Short human-readable summary (e.g. 'Campus Center Main Elevator Broken')

connector_id.description: Optional. Indoor connector (elevator) this closure disables, matching ids in scripts/curated-connectors.json. Without it, elevator closures snap to the nearest elevator within 30 m.

last_confirmed.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent verification; used for algorithmic freshness labeling

confirmations_count.description: Number of community confirmations validating this outage

example.title: Campus Center Concourse Elevator Out
example.description: Hydraulic failure reported by Facilities. Service crew dispatched.
